war_declared.text: The council has been patient with {enemy_faction} for long enough. Now it has run out of patience, and so have I :)
{my_faction} has sent its regrets to {enemy_faction}. A pity they will only read them once the banners are up.
War with {enemy_faction}, then. I did say the council would come round eventually. Some of us always saw it coming.
Let it be recorded that {my_faction} tried diplomacy first. {enemy_faction} simply refused to listen, which is their own affair.

peace_made.text: Peace between {my_faction} and {faction} is signed. Some of us arranged the terms while others were still shouting.
{faction} and {my_faction} have agreed to stop bleeding on each other. I suggested it weeks ago, in a corridor, quietly.
A treaty with {faction} is good for trade and better for my ledgers. Ask me about the clauses, if you can keep a secret.
Terms agreed with {faction}. The council will vote on them, of course, but the real vote was held in private :)

player_joined_my_faction.text: {player} has sworn to {my_faction}. Welcome to the council's good graces, such as they are.
{player} now flies the colours of {my_faction}. I shall reserve judgement until the first vote, as is only proper.
{player}, I am glad you chose {my_faction}. Keep your ledgers tidy and your friends closer, as they say in Vignebel.
{player}, you took your time deciding. {my_faction} remembers who hesitated, and so do I, at length.

player_left_my_faction.text: {player} has left {my_faction} for {faction}. How very brave of them to leave so loudly, and so early.
{player} has gone over to {faction}. Loyalty is a fine thing, provided it pays. I wish them every fortune.
{player}, you will find {faction} far less forgiving than I have been. Think on that before the next council.
{player}, I am sorry to see you go to {faction}. Should you tire of their company, my door is still open.

player_granted_fief.text: {fief} has been granted to {player}. Results are rewarded, it seems, and I did note that the council was listening.
So {player} holds {fief} now. A fine reward for a fine bit of lobbying, I am told. I was not asked, naturally.
{player}, {fief} is yours now. I hope its walls hold better than the promises that bought them.
{player}, congratulations on {fief}. Remember who spoke for you in the chamber. I certainly will.

whisper_alliance_offer.text: {player}, {rival} has been promising {enemy_faction} our votes. I have a better offer, built on a shared grievance.
Between us, {player}, {enemy_faction} will not hold their ground past the spring council. Stand with me against {rival}.
{player}, you and I have always understood each other. {rival} does not, and that is their weakness. Shall we use it on {enemy_faction}?
{player}, a word in private. {rival} is telling everyone they are untouchable. Shall we find out how wrong they are?

my_faction_took_fief.text: {fief} is ours again, taken from {enemy_faction} while they were busy with their feuds. {my_faction} rejoices, quietly.
The banners of {my_faction} now fly over {fief}. {enemy_faction} will be writing letters about this for months.
{fief} has fallen to {my_faction}. A fine day for the council, and an even finer day for my memory of who promised what.
Word is {fief} changed hands today, from {enemy_faction} to {my_faction}. I do enjoy it when plans come together.

player_took_my_fief.text: {player} has taken {fief}. Clever, if you like your victories bought with other people's trust.
{fief} went to {player} this week. I shall be writing a strongly worded letter to the council, in my best hand.
{player}, you have {fief} now. Enjoy the walls. I shall enjoy watching how long you keep them.
{player}, {fief} was mine before it was yours. Do not worry, I keep track of such debts, and I always collect.

encounter_alliance_yes.text: Ah, {player}, I was hoping you would ask. Against {rival} and {enemy_faction} we shall make a fine pair. Shall we sign it now?
Very well, {player}. An alliance against {enemy_faction} suits me, and {rival} has been insufferable for some time.
{player}, you have always had a good eye for opportunity. I accept. Let the council hear of it only once it is done.
Agreed, {player}. We shall keep {rival} guessing, and {enemy_faction} will learn what patience costs them.

encounter_alliance_no.text: No, {player}. You came to me with a proposal and no list of favours owed. I do not treat that as a serious offer.
I think not, {player}. {rival} would take it as a sign of weakness, and I cannot afford to look weak before the council.
Not today, {player}, I am sorry. Ask me again after the spring vote, and bring more than good intentions.
Your offer is noted, {player}, and so is the look on your face. I am not in the business of trusting loud bargainers.

ambient_chatter.text: Rain again in {town}. I hear the roads toward {village} are a swamp, which is excellent news for anyone who likes to wait :)
Has anyone noticed the market in {town} is short of wine? I am sure it is a coincidence, as most things are.
Lag on the eastern road again, so do not expect a quick reply from me. The council meets regardless, I am told.
Would anyone trade news from {village}? I will swap two rumours for one honest answer, which is a fair rate.
